title: Pokémon TCG Chandelure Sword & Shield - Lost Origin 026/196 Holo Holo Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Chandelure card from the Sword & Shield - Lost Origin set of the Pokémon TCG features a stunning holo finish that is sure to impress collectors. With a HP of 150, this Fire-type card is a valuable addition to any deck. The card number is 026/196 and it is part of the Holo Rare rarity collection.

As a fan of the Pokémon TCG, you know the value of adding rare cards to your collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this beautiful Chandelure card. Add it to your collection today!
